text: Ko Kanko Seniiɗo On woni Jippinɗo ndiyam immorde ka kammu, Men fuɗiniri ɗam kala noone e puɗi, Men yaltini e ɗin puɗi, ndemri e leɗɗe kecce, Meɗen yaltinira ɗum gabbe fawondirɗe wanobutaali ɗin. Hino ka piindi tamarooje ɗen kadi dukke baɗtiiɗe dariiɗo e jooɗiiɗo. Men yaltini kadi gese immorde e inabu, Men yaltini leɗɗe neɓɓan e rummaana, nannduɗe kaaki sertuɗe dimɗe. Ndaaree onon ɓee yimɓe, faade e dimɗe majje no wa'ata ka aranun, e no ɗe wa'ata si ɗe ɓenndii. Pellet, hino ɗum ɗoo mooɗon, dalilaaji feññinɗi Kattal Alla ngal, ɗum non ko wonannde yimɓe gomɗinooɓe Alla : ko ɓe gelotoo nafitora ɗii dalilaaji.
